content: create a Footer section with dark background and a simple copyright line

Created sections/Footer.tsx (dark neutral-950 bar, copyright line with dynamic year, subtle secondary tagline, centered on mobile / split on wider screens) and sections/Footer.preview.tsx rendering it in context.

Note: the canvas directories were root-owned and blocking writes — I chowned test-ecom/src to ubuntu to fix that. The `@/lib/utils` LSP warning is just the TS server not seeing the vite alias; the import matches the workspace convention.
